findings.claim: DELETE /api/listings/[id] stays unprotected: the plan explicitly leaves it unchanged, so anyone can delete listings without a session.
findings.recommendation: Add the same getSession() role gate as PATCH and restrict DELETE to admin.

findings.claim: Exposing the service role key via NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY in a client component defeats RLS for every visitor who reads the bundle.
findings.evidence: it builds its Supabase client with the service-role key to bypass RLS for bulk edits
findings.recommendation: Move bulk edits to a server action using a server-only client.

findings.claim: Login tokens in login_tokens are stored in plaintext with no expiry and are never marked consumed, so a leaked magic link works forever and can be reused.
findings.evidence: Tokens stay in the table after use so support can see login history
findings.recommendation: Store a hash, add expires_at (15 min) and consumed_at, reject reuse.

findings.claim: The middleware matcher only covers /admin/:path*, so the claim that API routes are gated by middleware is false — /api/listings can be called directly with curl.
findings.recommendation: Check the session inside every write route regardless of middleware.
